title: Oracle time-based blind SQLi (DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP)
references: note: Oracle DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP(3) delay (requires EXECUTE on DBMS_LOCK)
remediation: Use parameterised queries / prepared statements so request data is bound as a value and can never alter query structure. Never build SQL by string concatenation; apply least-privilege DB accounts and disable stacked queries as defence in depth.
